items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: In that short, Disney, that Disney did with Goodman

ctx.x: In that short, Disney, that Disney did with Goodman, I made -- and we recorded it first, and Disney had a keyboard and this keyboard was like a kite and these black and white things went right out into infinity. That's where he drew -- he drew a thing called Make Mine Music. He drew a cartoon character, actually added characters to the Goodman trio, for a little short subject in the movies.
